_help: Add one object to 'sessions' for every date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; 'slots' are the daily time blocks [start, end] in 24h. Past sessions disappear after their end date. Both language versions read this file. Registration: sessions with mode 'online' use the 'online' form in 'forms', all others the 'in-person' form; the program name and the dates are pre-filled (the program name is the 'practice', or 'formProgram' if you want a different name in the form). Optional per session: practiceTail (an emphasised ending after the program name, e.g. 'online'), registrationOpens (YYYY-MM-DD, the day registration opened; used by Google as the offer's start date, default is today), form ('in-person' or 'online' to force a form), registerUrl (a completely different form or link, text or {en,de}; a mailto: link also works), registerLabel, mode ('in-person' default, 'online' or 'mixed'), onlineUrl, location (own venue), kind (e.g. 'Retreat'), price (a number, or text such as {en,de} for 'On request'), language, and omit 'slots' for multi-day retreats. See '_examples'.

description.en: Two-day classical Hatha Yoga workshop on Yogasanas, structured by Sadhguru and taught by Nanda in Kollbrunn near Zurich. Two 2.5-hour sessions per day. No prior experience required.
description.de: Zweitägiger Workshop zu klassischen Hatha-Yoga-Yogasanas nach der Struktur von Sadhguru, unterrichtet von Nanda in Kollbrunn bei Zürich. Zwei 2,5-stündige Einheiten pro Tag. Keine Vorerfahrung erforderlich.
